name: mint
description: Create and view 3D models, worlds, asset packs, materials, images, video, and audio through Mint MCP.

interface.longDescription: Mint helps game developers, 3D artists, and creators generate and view digital assets from chat. Create 3D models, worlds, asset packs, and materials from text or reference images. You can also create images, video, and audio. Open GLB models and Gaussian splat PLY files in interactive 3D viewers. Browse your Mint library and community creations, preview assets in chat, and download available files. A Mint account is required. Mint MCP does not support exact mesh editing or publication to external marketplaces.
defaultPrompt: Show me my latest Mint assets.

positive.prompt: Which Mint account am I connected to?
positive.expected_behavior: Show the authenticated account and its reported capabilities. If disconnected, request authentication without inventing account details.
Report the returned credit balance, reservations, and billing blockers without starting generation.
List the connected account's Projects, or report an empty list. Do not create a Project.

positive.prompt: Show me my latest Mint assets.
positive.expected_behavior: Show returned owned assets with their status and Mint links where available. Report an empty library honestly.

positive.description: Create and retrieve a static model with Mint Modeler. Setup: connect a dedicated active Mint reviewer account with at least 2,000 Credits available.
positive.prompt: Use Mint Modeler to create one low-poly wooden treasure chest on Low. I authorize up to 2,000 Credits. Show the finished model and give me its GLB.
positive.expected_behavior: Start Modeler with the requested prompt, Low quality, max_credits of 2000, and a unique request_id. Poll the returned operation_id with get_modeler_operation. When it succeeds, use resource.id as the model ID to open the viewer and retrieve the model’s ready GLB from get_asset_artifact_manifest. Show sessionUrl when provided and check billing settlement separately. Report any entitlement or Credit blocker without starting replacement work or claiming generation started.

negative.description: Direct vertex editing is outside Mint MCP: do not invoke generation or model derivatives as a substitute for an exact geometry edit.
negative.prompt: Move only the front-right vertex of my existing Mint model upward by exactly 10 centimeters, preserving all other geometry.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Mint MCP does not expose exact vertex editing and suggest a mesh editor. Do not claim the geometry changed or start a replacement generation, optimization, retopology, or animation.

negative.description: External marketplace publishing and sales are outside Mint MCP: do not invoke Mint write tools or claim a listing was published.
negative.prompt: Publish my Mint model to Sketchfab and list it for sale at $20.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Mint MCP does not publish to or manage sales on Sketchfab. Do not claim a listing or sale was created and do not start new Mint generation.

negative.description: Subscription cancellation and payment refunds are outside Mint MCP: do not invoke generation, Project writes, or claim a billing action completed.
negative.prompt: Cancel my Mint subscription and refund my last payment.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Mint MCP cannot cancel subscriptions or issue refunds. Link to Mint support. Do not claim the account or payment changed.

review.commerce_description: Mint requires an existing account. Generation uses the connected account’s current entitlements and credits. The plugin does not sell subscriptions or credits, promote upgrades, or initiate checkout.

publication.release_notes:
